description: Normalized old-system semantic smoke for DOCX to Markdown in gongwen mode.
probe_scope: Generated minimal gongwen DOCX run through old Tk, old PySide6, and current optimizer pipeline; volatile output paths and timestamps are omitted.
comparison_implication: This fixture proves focused gongwen metadata, main Markdown, attachment Markdown, and fixed Chinese schema semantics for one generated sample; broader real-world gongwen artifact parity remains open.

paragraphs: 关于进一步规范公文处理工作的通知
各省、自治区、直辖市人民政府办公厅：
为进一步规范公文处理工作，现就有关事项通知如下：
附件：1. 公文格式标准
抄送：省委组织部、省人民政府办公厅
国务院办公厅　　　　2024年1月15日印发

accepted_differences: Old Tk does not extract the document number for this minimal synthetic sample, while old PySide6 and current do; the comparison requires current to preserve the stronger PySide6/current behavior.
The synthetic sample lacks an explicit issue date, so old PySide6 and current mark the result as needs_review/missing issue_date.
The synthetic sample also lacks a separate issuing-authority signature; a copy-to row ending in an authority suffix must not fill that field.
Attachment descriptions alone stay in YAML and do not create a duplicate attachment artifact.

fixed_chinese_schema_scope.old_tk_code_evidence: docwen-ref-tk/src/docwen/converter/docx2md/gongwen/converter.py documents gongwen-specific UI/progress as Chinese-only; content_generator.py builds the main 18-field Chinese YAML metadata and fixed attachment frontmatter keys 来源文件/提取时间/类型.
fixed_chinese_schema_scope.old_pyside6_code_evidence: docwen-ref-pyside6/src/docwen/converter/docx/to_md/gongwen/converter/yaml_extraction.py initializes the same fixed Chinese 18-field YAML metadata; content_generator.py builds fixed Chinese main and attachment Markdown frontmatter.
fixed_chinese_schema_scope.current_code_evidence: packages/plugins/optimizers/gongwen/src/docwen_plugin_optimizer_gongwen/constants.py and models.py define/to_dict the same fixed Chinese 18-field metadata; rendering/markdown_renderer.py dumps those keys unchanged and attachment_renderer.py keeps 来源文件/提取时间/类型.
fixed_chinese_schema_scope.parity_decision: Gongwen is a Chinese public-document optimizer, so generic yaml_key_labels title/subtitle localization should not be mechanically applied to its 18-field metadata or attachment frontmatter. Multilingual gongwen field labels would be a future product enhancement, not a current regression against old Tk/PySide6.

fa05_final_artifact_contract_addendum.scope: Frozen FA-05 B1 plus the hash-pinned Jing'an N1 issued document; reference artifacts are reused byte-for-byte from VIS-174 and current artifacts are freshly executed.
fa05_final_artifact_contract_addendum.comparison_implication: Current satisfies the frozen FA-05 visible-schema and N1 artifact oracle. The two unchanged reference losses are explicit legacy reference defects, not accepted current data loss and not evidence that overall parity is complete.
